name: nexus-healthcare
description: Sehatra — national health network (React PWA + Express API, SQLite/PostgreSQL)

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c green,yellow "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.reset-data: node -e "const fs=require('fs');for(const f of ['server/data/omnicare.db','server/data/omnicare.db-wal','server/data/omnicare.db-shm','server/data/db.json'])fs.rmSync(f,{force:true});console.log('Local database removed — demo data will be re-seeded on next start')"
scripts.prod:local: npm run build && cross-env NODE_ENV=production npm start
scripts.catalyst:deploy: npm run catalyst:build && cd catalyst-build && catalyst deploy
